title: 2026 UK ETS HSE target-error recalculation QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS for hospital or small emitters: how to comply
UK ETS Hospital and Small Emitter status

facts.fact: An error in reportable emissions used to calculate an HSE emissions target can trigger regulator correction.
The correction rule also applies to revised targets created under the banking provisions.
The regulator may determine reportable emissions when correcting such an error.
The regulator may calculate revised emissions targets for the current scheme year.
The regulator may calculate revised targets for future scheme years.
An operator's discovery of an error is not itself the regulator's final determination.
The correction is based on reportable-emissions inputs used for the target.
The rule concerns HSE emissions targets, not allowance allocation or parcel emissions.
Corrected HSE targets are implemented through the regulatory permit framework.
The original error, corrected emissions and revised target basis should remain traceable for QA.

guard_patterns.rule: Tie correction to reportable-emissions target inputs.
Do not replace regulator determination with operator assertion.
Preserve current and future target effects.
Keep HSE target correction distinct from allowances.
